metadata.title: PSPackageMan
metadata.description: Creates a GitHub (Private or Public) Gist to host the details about your required apps. You can create more than one list to customize your requirements. These lists are then used to install or upgrade apps on Windows using Chocolatey or Winget. With this, you can install all your utilities on any machine unattended.

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

evidence.snippet: $AllGist = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url -Method Get -Headers $headers -ErrorAction Stop  …  Invoke-Expression -Command "winget export -o $($env:tmp)\winget-extract.json" | Out-Null
